node.statement: With node 1.1 as a hard validation prerequisite (not a merely conditional meta-assumption), node 1.1 supplies the finite-dimensional commutative C*-algebras D_r and C, projection bases {Pi_a}_{a=1}^r and {1}, sufficiently accurate non-unital inclusions v_D and w, and the identities v_D(I_r)=v(I_r), w(1)=Q, and v_D(Pi_a)=R_a. The allowed external lem-extcb-corner-dimension-additivity therefore yields a linear bijection S_{v_D(I_r),w(1)} -> direct-sum_{a=1}^r S_{v_D(Pi_a),w(1)}. Substitution gives S_{v(I_r),Q} -> direct-sum_{a=1}^r S_{R_a,Q}; hence dim S_{v(I_r),Q}=sum_a dim S_{R_a,Q}. The separately validated node 1.3.2 gives dim S_{R_a,Q}=d for every a, so the dimension is r*d. This child is explicitly barred from validation until node 1.1 is validated.
